newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka to tender for 50,000 tonnes rice soon.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to tender for 50,000 tonnes rice soon.

text.p: Sri Lanka will soon invite bids for 50,000 tonnes of rice for November/December delivery, officials of the state buying arm Cooperative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Monday.
"A firm decision will be made probably this week and invitations will go out soon" a CWE official said.
"The new purchase will be for delivery in November and December and there will be no restrictions on the origin of rice," he added.
The CWE said earlier it had bought 12,500 tonnes of Indian rice at $250.40 per tonnes c&f and 12,500 tonnes of Vietnamese rice at $238.49 tonnes c&f for October delivery.
